## Slack Node

**WHAT IT DOES:**
* Sends messages to Slack channels or users
* Can create channels, update messages, add reactions
* Supports rich formatting with attachments and blocks
* Requires Slack app with OAuth token

**HOW TO USE:**
1. Create [Slack app](https://api.slack.com/apps) in workspace
2. Follow instructions on [this page](https://docs.n8n.io/integrations/builtin/credentials/slack/) for the next steps
3. Add required scopes: in this example, it's `chat:write` to send private messages to users
4. Install app to workspace
5. Copy Bot OAuth Token to n8n credentials
6. Select channel and compose message

**AUTHENTICATION:**
* OAuth2 or Access Token
* Scopes determine permissions

**LIMITATIONS:**
* Token rotation must be OFF for production
* Rate limits apply per workspace

**USE CASES:**
* Real-time transaction alerts
* System error notifications
* Daily report summaries
* Team collaboration updates

**REFERENCE:**
https://docs.n8n.io/integrations/builtin/app-nodes/n8n-nodes-base.slack/

## Example

**MESSAGE FORMATTING:**
* Use expressions to insert dynamic data
* Format: `{{ $json.fieldName }}`
* Supports markdown formatting

**CHANNEL SELECTION:**
* Public channels: #channel-name
* Private channels: Use channel ID
* Direct messages: @username or user ID

## Exercise

**TASK:**
1. Create a Slack app in your workspace
2. Add scopes: chat:write, channels:read
3. Install app and copy Bot OAuth Token
4. Create Slack credentials in n8n
5. Change user ID to your user ID
6. Modify message to include transaction status
7. Execute and verify message appears

**SUCCESS CRITERIA:**
✓ Message posts to your chat with the bot
✓ Dynamic values display correctly
✓ Formatting renders properly
